_about: Golden prompts for the 5-dimension scorer (apps/api/eval/README.md). Bands are what a careful human applying the rubric in packages/scoring/src/score-prompt.mjs would accept — deliberately wide; the harness measures run-to-run spread and band hits, not exact scores. `dims` bands are optional per dimension; `overall` is the rounded mean the API reports.
